angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 872,666 km at 60.39 pc = 0.19 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 16.5598 +/- 0.0221 mas (same row, RUWE 1.04): 60.39 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.254 (1.229 to 1.280) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 872,666 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.988 (0.948 to 1.028) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5778 +/- 1 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 1090159839002347136: teff_gspphot 5777.976 K (16th-84th percentiles 5776.9736-5778.8833), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 1090159839002347136: teff_gspphot 5777.976 K (16th-84th percentiles 5776.9736-5778.8833), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/nasti.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.236, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 68988 (pscomppars): spectral type G2 V, from Vogt et al. 2002 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2002ApJ...568..352V/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 68988 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.3052 dex, from Rosenthal et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021ApJS..255....8R/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 68988 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.22184, from Gaia DR2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...616A...1G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 68988 (pscomppars): age 6 Gyr, from Vogt et al. 2002 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2002ApJ...568..352V/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 68988 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2.84 km/s, from Butler et al. 2006 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2006ApJ...646..505B/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
